import.title: Import from Super Productivity
import.intro: Export a backup from Super Productivity’s settings, then choose the file here. Open tasks come over with their project, their urgent and important tags (as matrix quadrants), their planned day, deadline, notes and subtasks. Done tasks stay behind, and importing the same file again adds nothing new.
import.notJson: This file is not a Super Productivity backup.

injust.title: Injust Release
injust.intro: Injust Release can send its steps, studio stages and posts to an Injust project here, and gets back what you tick, skip or reopen. Create a token, then paste this address and the token in Injust Release › Settings › Tasks › MossyDew.
injust.waitingFirst: Token ready: waiting for Injust Release to send its tasks.
injust.lastFeed: Injust Release last sent its tasks on {moment}. Changes waiting for it: {count}.
injust.once: The token is shown only now. Replacing it disconnects the old one.

app.title: App
app.prompt: Install MossyDew to open it from your Dock or Start menu in its own window. You stay signed in and everything syncs.
app.manual: To get MossyDew in its own window: in Safari, choose File › Add to Dock; in Chrome or Edge, use the install icon in the address bar.
app.installed: MossyDew is installed on this device.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.intro: Choose the app’s colours, just for you. MossyDew uses the same themes as MossyTrunk.
